reviews.text: The idea is great and the graphic matches the theme. Sadly nothing gameplay-wise has changed since the demo. Game is still punishing you where ever it is possible. I have to play constantly passive and wait how the AI acts, then I can make my moves and hope the AI plays dumb. If I dont play passive (aka aggressive) I lose my pieces so fast because the AI covers their pieces pretty well. This way it does not make fun, at least for me.

The design is cool and all, but it's difficult to recommend a rougelike that I won on the very first run I played. The replayability comes from unlocking different gambits but if i immediately won in the first run, what's the need for anything I unlocked? There's mutators as well, and i know i could have gotten really lucky but if i play a game like this i expect to lose a bunch, not much draw for me to keep playing now.

这个游戏在风格打磨上下了功夫，实际上，我们不难看出它很像小丑牌，小丑牌的质感其实我不觉得特别好，有点子软或者失真的迷幻，不过这个游戏的手感还尚可。 但是，它的玩法问题比以缺乏深度而闻名的小丑牌的问题可能更大，游戏的最主要环节还是.......下棋，我指的是纯正传统国际象棋。很多道具（“奇兵”）并不能让你变得有多轮椅，你得到不了什么强化，并且整局游戏看起来怎么都像一个变着法的传统规则残局模拟器（而不是在原有规则上拓展开来甚至放飞自我的rougelike游戏），它更像是原版规则的象棋。而且你是不能悔棋的！一步想错了整把就崩了。 各种遗物/道具的设计有一些保守，你仿佛只能得到一些补充棋子的牌，一些给钱的牌，一些满足条件跳过回合的牌......最离经叛道的遗物类型在我看来是能让你提前升变的遗物，但总体打下来还是传统象棋，你一子我一子。 你的棋子是有限的，被吃掉下一局也不能用了，基本上你经受不起和ai换子，诚实地讲，这和我们想象的rougelike'差距有点大。一般也许我们会期望每个棋子都能复用。然后不断地扩充自己的阵容库，或者强化个别的棋子。换言之，我期望这也许是一个建造build的游戏。 但是这个游戏和我想得完全不同，所有棋子都是一次性用品，它们不是被看作你的build战力，而是一些有限的生存资源，你实际上要做的是生存资源管理。然后许多道具的用途就是单纯的补充棋子！而这对游戏的玩法多样性真的没有什么益处。实际上，把棋子做成可以不断强化或者联动（你知道的，让这个棋子游戏变成”战棋“游戏）是我一开始所设想的。但是游戏却把这变成了一个.....资源管理生存挑战。而堆积在”补充棋子资源“这一项上的遗物是完全不能帮助丰富游戏的玩法的。 我承认我不懂这游戏，我也承认我不适应的原因是这游戏完全不是我所想的那类型，我甚至都没到过第三关，我才玩了一小时，但是我真的感到难以继续下去。无法悔棋的传统国际象棋残局练习器对于非专业象棋爱好者来说过于艰难和单调。
甚至不如衔尾蛇国王，国象的精髓就是弃兵，现在反倒是每个兵都要精打细算，而且还有数量上限，买棋还贼贵 建议还是以杀王为底层逻辑，又能限制战损还有更多的博弈空间 5.6二更 终于靠幽灵马套路通关一次了，但是还是太靠运气了。（被吃获得一个幽灵马+放置获得一个幽灵复制） 附种子：648474112

Overall, an enjoyable but deeply flawed experience. Death by a thousand cuts. * The game has unskippable animations constantly, 7 seconds for a gacha item to open, 15 seconds boss cutscenes (5 times per game), weird delays with every actions * Lots of bugs that should've been ironed out with QA * Very unbalanced systems A) Queens are default the best unless you get a special relic that says otherwise B) infinite duplication is an intended mechanic and can be done from the first shop, if you get lucky, without any 'jokers'. Leading to rounds being less focused on beating the opponent and more, stalling for as long as possible to print mostly Queens C) Tiles are not made equally, ghost tile + gold tiles are by far the best due to their synergy * RNG factors mid-round in the form of tiles that dissapear, taking the piece on it. These provide 1 turn warning, meaning if you get particularly unlucky you will guarantee lose a piece, and with good luck it'll beat your opponents for you * No benefit for going fast, unlike say Balatro, where you benefit from using few hands, there's no such incentive here. Infact, it's reversed, you are highly incentivises to play slow, stall turns until the AI displays and take advantage of them * Aggression is actively discincentivised in turn of enemy layouts. As pieces are lost forever some layouts of opponents bases can only be removed, without casualties, with any consistency by just passing turns * AI is completely unpredictable. The game won't tell you where the AI plans to move, and it will frequently make objectively weird decisions, including just, moving to a tile that's about to dissapear or not moving away from one that is. Honestly I could keep going but I'll leave it there, Devs, if you're watching. This game is good, please spend your time doing QoL changes. If things improve I'll update my review. Wish you the best because this is a genuinely great game. I do not recommend this game as it is

I feel like a lot of the reviews that mention the Ai being bad or there being no actual deck building haven't actually gone past stage 3. The further you go into the game the harder it gets, but there a bunch of synergies you can make with gambits etc. in which a lot of players ignore (the first run I won had me basically mass producing pieces and skipping turns constantly). The game is like balatro, but chess, and I do like the mechanics of the game. Though the game does not function as proper chess since there are scenarios where your situation is a tad awful (I'm looking at you stage 5 game 5), everything is winnable to an extent depending on RNG and how well the player utilizes their pieces and gambits. Again a lot of these negative reviews are kinda bad in my opinion since they probably have not done much in the game or figured much out.

After playing the rival chess-balatro game "Gambit", I have to say... Gambonanza is addicting and the music is incredible for an indie game. There are unique bosses and difficulty unlocks. If you like chess, indie games full of fun references (Zelda, Rambo, there must be dozens) or roguelikes like Inscryption (ESPECIALLY INSCYPTION and you will learn why lol) Gambonanza is a must-play.

TL;DR: Game needs more polish and features to justify the price. Either the price needs to come down or the devs need to flesh the game out more. There is fun here, but it's not enough to justify the current price. Wait for a sale and a few updates. The default price is too high for what's on offer. The price (at least for my country) is a dollar higher than Balatro; which is absurd when you compare the two - and this game is begging to be compared to Balatro. The art, ui, music and premise of the game are basically straight up copied - which is fine, Balatro had a great thing going and it's fine to be inspired by it. T hat said, it feels like this game just wanted to be Balatro but Chess puzzles, and it's not amazing at it. It's not terrible, I had some fun, but it feels like the options the game presents doesn't have enough depth. One of the levers balatro had was being able to level up individual cards and hands, which doesn't have an analogue in this game. There aren't any fairy pieces from what I've played so far for you to unlock, nor can you give special upgrades to any of your pieces. You also lose your pieces when they get captured, which means there's a constant economic need to buy more pieces. This feels like a less than ideal economic game design pattern; I'd rather have more things to spend on to get powerful instead of constantly having to replenish my pieces, who's losses are sometimes inevitable (although I did blunder lots too, so there's that.) The english localization isn't great either, there's a lot of confusing wording on important info. All that said, I had fun but I would recommend for the devs to flesh out some of the mechanics, because right now the price is insulting when you compare this game to its clear inspiration. Buy it if the deal is good and there's clear signs of life from the devs.

as someone who rank 2000 in chess.com. i should say 95% AI player moves is worse than "bad" in chess.com but i think if it does the right move players wont survive more than three turns in most late games. but sometimes it acts like it doesnt know the rules at all and keeps sending its stuffs to die for no reasons, that takes away the joy to beat it. A game learn from Balatro CANT be a 2/10 game cuz the core is good enough, but this game lacks the blood-pumping moment to see your points go insane in Balatro or you hit the final card to win a full house. Chess is a serious game, you need to calm down and think over and over again. i feel like the team should create more "fun" setup of games to make each game feel fresh, cuz if i want to play serious chess, i will go to chess.com. if i want to have fun in chess, waiting for AI to make dumb moves like putting its queen to my queen's front, is NOT fun. i didnt feel i win becuz i play well, i win becuz the AI is made to be a rank 1-499 player (sometimes it could catch your dum move for sure) in chess.com or otherwise I cant win. and effects of each "Joker cards" needs some clarifications, some i thought it means this-and-that, but after my move it turns out not, and i lost the game afterwards. over all i think its a good idea to combine chess with blatro, but the team needs to balance the serious in chess and the crazy combo-build in Balatro, and of cuz betting in poker. from what i had played, the game feels a bit "too serious" and less "fun", i hope more creative design to be brought in the game, and make it better. 6.5/10

并非肉鸽、也并非小丑牌like，空有其形的左右脑互搏产物。 缺点有三： 1.弈子阵亡就是永久阵亡，这是违背肉鸽的原理的。肉鸽的爽点极大程度来源于build，框架是“底层框架+成套收集并保留的词条”，小丑牌本身就是扎实的德扑，配合卡组的删删减减（这样可以玩同花或是炸弹这种特定牌型，再辅以遗物的乘区）；或者说云顶之弈这种自走“棋”其实也是每个阶段的弈子重新复活，主打的是阵容的强度检验。 这游戏就是每把都得精打细算防战损，但是说白了我感受到的我的“未吃战损”不是因为我的chess水平有多高，纯是因为AI很唐，就见boss之前的关卡很多时候AI就是走过来送吃，我并没有从这个设计里感觉到我多机灵。 再说流派这边的问题，新手种子第一把是固定种，就教你玩兵。好现在我拿到了兵吃子连动、兵跳过升变、兵升变给王。那问题来了，我兵升变完了我没有兵啊！那我的遗物又要怎么触发呢？是，我现在是拿了3个王随便乱杀，但这肉鸽吗我请问了？？ 兵系都还好，好歹还有兵每回合免费生一个跟第一动如果动兵再生一个，那我没抓到的情况下怎么办呢？只能靠经济硬顶。 2.再说经济系统，兄弟，你真的想过你自己为什么是10块产1块利息吗，为什么各个弈子是这个价格？不能因为小丑牌云顶之弈都是这个经济系统你直接抄吧，这对吗？弈子很多时候商店刷的不是自己想要的，2选1跟3选1加成7块跟10块我理解也是平衡了弈子间的概率算的期望，但问题是这块不该是期望跟随机，那我的build怎么办啊，不还是玩成蠕动了？？ 3.遗物的设计跟崩毁系统也是超级败笔，兄弟你不是个下棋游戏吗？为什么我的遗物80%都是1/2触发跟1/3触发啊，吃子随机崩毁一个为什么会直接刷脸上掉落啊？？一边想让我每关做精妙的诘将棋一边又给我喂随机的答辩我真是服了你了。 综评3/10，设计师左右脑互搏的神奇产物，蜥蜴君评测即使说自己是抖M我也不推荐任何人吃这坨，我宁可你是个线性解谜游戏每关右边发我5条特规（遗物）让我用精妙的算力破关，也好过吃这口随机的屎，它既不肉鸽、也没有乐趣。

打红温了，这游戏趣味性有，但更多是折磨的设计： 1.不让sl。大部分玩家应该都不是国象高手，国象本身又是错一招满盘皆输的游戏，实在想不通为什么不加个sl的条件。目前的难度太大了，挫败性极强，没有sl就纯恶心玩家。 2.大部分奇兵（小丑牌）的效果太垃圾。这游戏我更多的时间是去买强化棋格，凑幽灵棋子-黄金棋子的combo，这也是我能玩到的为数不多的肉鸽元素。设计这么多概率是几个意思？一个无法稳定触发的流派注定不会被大众选择，我能忍受你给的数值很小气，但大部分奇兵都要赌概率太蠢了。 这一点我再多说两句，本作非常缺少那种通用的强力奇兵，拿隔壁小丑牌举例，开局来张巴士我已经开始想怎么赢了，无论我这把玩什么都能用上，效果非常强力。而奇兵目前没看到这种感觉，基本要你倚靠单一的棋类去构筑，但这种单一构筑的奇兵你能凑出几个呢？大部分时间都是暴毙。 3.预制棋局，没有肉鸽的快感。进阶一开始固定选后，一阶段的几个阵我已经通了好几次了，一个后杀进去非常的无聊，这可能是游戏本身的限制问题。 4.沟槽的难度设计和经济系统。进阶一开始15块给一块的利息，这是拍大腿想出来的吗？本身本作就鼓励你买子兑子，没有幽灵棋格的话就陷入，不买棋打不过，打不过没有钱，没有钱买不了棋的死循环。经济系统是崩的，商店又卖我垃圾，我还要升棋盘去放子，我玩你的那个。 但我还是要给本作好评，因为这个游戏是肉眼可见的好玩，并且我相信优化一下会变成相当好玩的游戏，在保留肉鸽元素的同时加入大量的脑力思考，我很享受这种感觉。 求你了制作组，赶紧更新吧！！！

虽然我自己两次通关玩的还算有意思，但是乐趣完全来自于游戏本身的框架而非作者在此之上的设计，作者的每一处设计给人感觉都在限制玩家、提供挫败感，而非提供给玩家乐趣，因此完全不推荐给任何人。但是这个游戏底子很好，如果作者能意识到游戏应该让人玩的开心，有很大的进步潜力。 玩起来处处受到限制，没有SL，很容易一个眼瞎葬送精心运营几十分钟的整局游戏。就该默认难度提供SL功能。将一命模式作为挑战选项可选。 构筑部分相当于残疾人拼命运营一整局变成一个正常人。体系成型后也没有各种联动的爽感。大部分buff加成都只是蚊子腿程度可有可无，大量垃圾的buff更是让人毫无期待感很乏味，而且5个的数量限制加上一大堆的概率触发，更是导致构筑深度大大下降。大部分对局不是靠构筑起来的效果赢的，而是弱智电脑送子，以及弱智电脑超时后自己掉下悬崖。 整体玩起来的感受就相当于是跟一个国际象棋新手下棋，我自己让几个子加一堆限制陪对面练习的感觉。赢了不是我有多强而是对面太菜一堆失误。 演出很好。音乐不错。

这个游戏总体来说未来可期，但有一些问题导致游戏体验极度恶心，如果制作组能想到办法解决，那是非常有潜力的： 1.在其他所有棋子被吃掉前某个棋子无敌，这样的效果实在是过于强大了，国际象棋作为一个讲究子力交换的游戏，出现这样一个效果破坏了整个下棋体验，一个后无限横冲直撞不用考虑任何后果对任何一个棋手来说都是恶心至极的存在，这样的机制感觉完全无法接受 2.很多效果描述非常不清晰或难以找到，如黑白脸boss，并没有描述他如何切换不同颜色的脸，许多效果都要去猜测然后在实战中验证，导致初见体验很差 3.肉鸽讲究的就是在随机中寻找确定性，我至少在下棋的时候我希望我的每一步都是在自己掌控之中的，而不是求助于骰子，如果制作组想限制一些效果的触发频率，完全没必要用概率来限制，这一定程度是可以等价为频率的，如1/3概率触发的效果其实就是满足三次前置条件触发一次，这样玩家的掌控感就会强很多，我觉得这是非常有必要的，如果我在游戏中的一步棋下了以后我就要祈祷骰子的结果，那这样的棋下起来体验实在不怎么好 目前只想到这么多，在进一步体验后可能会给出更多的想法

我可以接受失着是国象的一环，但作为游戏来说落子无悔还是太过于硬核。我觉得这个游戏很有趣，但没有悔棋功能给游玩过程加了太多压力，以至于通了一盘以后很容易不想打开下一盘。即使是有限的悔棋功能（例如悔棋次数限制，或是被吃子后才能悔棋），对于游戏体验也会是很大的提升。 同时游戏如此直白地套用小丑牌的系统，却没有了开局策略差分，让我感觉少了很多乐趣。所有流派成型都要依赖局内运营，发牌员发什么玩什么，这让游玩体验有些不够新鲜。 总体来说底子是好的，价格也不贵，犯不上差评，但有很多可以后续补充的东西。

对于这款游戏我的整体评价是中评，但因为sbeam只有好评和差评我还是给一个好评的评价，作为游戏来说是有游戏性的，但是对玩家的限制太大了，没有sl和棋子死后直接销毁以及崩毁模式都会极大的影响玩家的游玩体验，很多时候都是明明已经有了不错的构筑但是因为自己的一次失误导致自己意外结束了这一局，会很有挫败感。这款游戏每一步都会保存并且对面的攻击范围没有显示，经常就会走错导致游戏直接结束，也许开发商可能认为肉鸽游戏失败后再开一局就是。但对玩家来说不是这样，你总不能要求我玩个游戏像下棋一样保持专注走好每一步吧，这只是个游戏而已。所以我还是希望开发商能加入sl，或者是棋局开始时保存而不是每一步都保存，又或者是加入显示对面棋子攻击范围的选项。 My overall rating for this game is average, but since Sbeam only has positive and negative reviews, I'll give it a positive one. As a game, it has some gameplay, but it's too restrictive for players. The lack of save/load (SL), the direct destruction of pieces upon death, and the collapse mode all greatly impact the player experience. Often, you have a good deck, but a single mistake leads to an unexpected game over, which is very frustrating. The game saves every move, and there's no display of the opponent's attack range, frequently resulting in mistakes and game over. Perhaps the developers think that in a roguelike game, you can just start another game after a loss. But that's not how it works for players. You can't expect me to be as focused as a chess player, making every move perfectly. It's just a game. Therefore, I hope the developers will add a save/load feature, or at least save at the start of the game instead of every move, or add an option to display the opponent's piece's attack range.
肉鸽游戏，体量还行 我不太欧，八九个小时才通关 通关之后还有挑战模式，太肝不打算玩了，打工人伤不起 这游戏的平衡做的不是太好，后期找到诀窍，直接一招鲜走遍天 总的来说，如果喜欢小丑牌的话，应该也会喜欢这个游戏的。推荐

有几个小问题，chess和Roguelike的融合没有太做好 第一是在国际象棋中换子是一个常见的策略，但是目前游戏机制明显不支持你换子。肉鸽游戏需要构建，流派发育需要时间，当棋子是永久性阵亡时，你的构筑的体系非常容易崩塌。 第二是经济系统，到中期掉子几乎无法避免，但是没有地方可以迅速补充流派的棋子，也没有足够的金额去补充，再加上没有SL，出现决策错误的惩罚非常大，经常剩一个棋子蠕动到下回合，商店又补充不了核心棋子，直接结束。 最后是遗物奇兵问题，最经典的就是王车易位的那个概率和兵视为XX。你王车奇兵的跳过回合概率计算在你移动棋子之后，在巨大的失误惩罚下，几乎无法去赌三分之一跳回合去吃子。但是选择防守策略跳回合又浪费了出手。如果改成先计算，然后告诉你下回合会跳过，再让你去连续走两次棋，可能会好不少。兵视为XX，但你兵到底线升变后，就吃不到原来的奇兵的效果了，类似的也有国王保护和皇后祝福这样的，棋子变后吃不到奇兵的效果了。 我觉得这是一款非常不错的独游，只是仍需打磨
不知道作者是否通关过自己游戏的最高难

极欠打磨的平衡，优秀的操作手感。不知为何我无法解锁任何成就 策略性非常强，比正常肉鸽游戏更考验智力和记忆（所以我实际不适合）。不能sl。比尖塔 房东 小丑牌更难（也可能是因为我纯粹下棋技术烂） 遗物系统平衡非常差（比如有的遗物卖3金币，触发给2，很快回本，有的遗物卖9，触发给2，然后条件还苛刻），局外发育很难指望，联动性不佳 最大的矛盾在于，电脑可以通过棋子互相掩护让玩家难以进攻，玩家的棋子会跨回合损耗，而电脑每次战斗都会有完整排列的阵型（和大量棋子），和可以无视后果地进攻，造成战损。
你很难找到一个比它玩法还要垃圾的肉鸽游戏。

原本我是非常期待国际象棋类的肉鸽游戏的，我个人很喜欢国际象棋以及它的各种变体，也挺喜欢玩小丑牌，最近忙完了各种事情满怀期待地玩通关了这个游戏的最高难度，最终的感受就是非常失望。 这个游戏无论是作为肉鸽，还是棋类的策略游戏，都是相当失败的，肉鸽没有爽的地方，或者说非常难让你爽起来，游戏中几乎处处是负反馈，敌方的棋子吃掉被吃掉对对方并没有太大的影响，而玩家一旦棋子被吃，除非你运营到不缺棋子与经济，不然对你的影响就会很大，玩家被吃掉的棋子被吃了就是没了，必须要通过奇兵或者购买重新获得，丢子惩罚过大，但是在3大关及以后敌方无脑堆棋子数量，加上棋盘不大导致棋子密度特别大，这种情况下不兑子是不可能的，玩家想通关就必须去思考如何稳定地补充自己的棋子，更像是运营游戏，反而不像策略游戏了。 如果你和我一样是奔着国际象棋来的，那么我推荐你快跑。我在lichess网站快棋1846分，最高到过1900，我觉得我对国象还是有一些理解的，国际象棋的核心围绕着杀王，而这个游戏是吃掉对方所有棋子，原国象中很多弃子攻杀，以及捉双等技巧都因为这个游戏模式以及丢子惩罚都是失效的，这个游戏就是吃吃吃吃吃，以及运营。会下国象在这个游戏中的优势就是不容易走出个blender，以及判断棋子预落点会快一点，别的和小白差不了多少，而且你玩国象玩得越多，越喜欢玩国象，很多地方就会越难受。我很难想象有一天我玩国际象棋竟然要考虑在没有攻杀的情况下要不要用马去兑掉对方的后，还有坍缩机制导致胜利的随机性，我知道作者不想让玩家能在一回合无尽地刷钱刷格子，但是坍缩这个机制带来的就是一些后期关卡玩家如果没能及时通关，运气不好的情况下最后就要和AI赌运气：看谁的棋子先掉下去，这个机制让很多优势局白白和棋或者失败，以及大劣势局有时可以直接赌对方的棋子坍缩，毕竟后期敌方的棋子远远多于我方。我认为这个机制总体是失败的，对策略性的打击过于严重了。 还有boss棋子，也就是其他棋子被吃完前自身不会被吃这种棋子，其实就是变体中的铁棋子，玩过国象变体的应该都知道这种棋子在没有棋子能针对的情况下有多逆天，尤其是boss皇后，在比较小的棋盘上给你来个捉双跟玩一样，吃你的棋子没有任何代价，还能追着你的棋子撕咬，你还不能吃它，只能一直逃命。这玩意的恶心程度实在是太高了，面对对方有boss棋子，要么慢慢磨棋盘让boss棋子被对方棋子挡着出不来，这么玩还很看对方AI配不配合你，要么顶着坍塌棋子直接吃，多点坍塌限制它的灵活性，或者运营好了靠着陷阱棋格和保护棋格过，我可以接受一些boss很强，但它总要有克制方法，boss棋子这种无赖式的你不能还手带来的负反馈就是拉满的。 此外，游戏处处都是小丑牌的影子，比如奇兵，其实就是小丑牌，商店系统和小丑牌的很像，代币就是小丑牌的补充包，改棋格类似于小丑牌改牌等等，但是这个游戏的难度远大于小丑牌，而且小丑牌不论是通金注，还是低底注去挑战无尽爆机，给的正反馈都是相当足的，这个游戏没有无尽，高难度下全程压力大，低难度又过于简单玩着很没意思，小丑牌我通了金注还乐意去挑战给各种牌组和小丑牌贴金，但这个游戏通了最高难度我的感想只是这一坨终于赤完了。 小丑牌的核心是小丑牌，这个游戏的对应核心位置就是奇兵，但是这个游戏的很多奇兵设计得相当失败，比如王车易位奇兵，1/3的概率跳过敌方回合，那我玩的时候是当成会跳，还是不会跳呢？我赌这1/3的概率敌方会被跳过，如果赌失败了带来的丢子惩罚巨大，因此想通过对于这种概率小丑就不得不去想着最坏情况，也就是认为它不会触发。我且不说我花经济买来它当它没用这一点有多离谱，就是把它当成游玩过程中的一个惊喜小buff，但这是棋类游戏，我必须思考下一步会发生什么，当你思考半天后终于算清楚各种情况时，啪！敌方的回合被跳过啦！惊喜可能就成了惊吓。还有什么卖后和车给王，象被吃1/3概率给王，1/5概率给黄金格，升变根据马的数量给钱等等等等，我已经无力吐槽了，弱的可以说是一点用没有，强的如白皇后无限印后，哑剧白象吃子跳回合，天启骑士吃子与被吃给幻影马等等这种奇兵又有些强得有点离谱了，只能说平衡稀烂。而小丑牌的大部分小丑在过渡、经济、终端和经济上各自有各自的用处，就连马戏团长，偶像，男爵这种正常通关完全意义不明的，在无尽中也有自个的用处，我估计是作者看到小丑牌的成功，太着急占据肉鸽棋类游戏的生态位了，没有好好平衡导致的。 这个游戏最抽象的，就是后难度以上的全体奇兵易腐效果，小丑牌橙注也就一部分小丑带易腐，而且成长类小丑不会带易腐，作者是怎么想的能让全体奇兵易腐？很多没有配合的经济类奇兵五个回合能挣的经济补上成本也过不了10块钱，还有龙蛋奇兵这种每过两回合升级一次的带个易腐是更逆天的，第五回合进商店你不卖它自动消失，到不了6回合你卖了就相当于占着个奇兵位置四回合，然后用一个传奇奇兵换两个随机史诗奇兵，这条件狗看了都摇头。的确这个游戏在对单一棋子完成奇兵的构筑后确实会很容易通关，比如象带个哑剧和概率把白格子视为黑格，再带个概率翻倍和龙马，就能把所有关卡当成路边一条踢死，作者为了保证难度设计对奇兵的阻碍是正常的，但是这种设计是不是用力过猛了？很多配合需要的奇兵难以凑齐，这样粗暴地易腐所有奇兵只会让高难度下的构筑难上加难，最终就是捡到什么用什么，丝毫没有考虑玩家的游戏体验。 总的来说还是失望，这游戏优点也有一些，我能想到的就是bgm还可以，以及很多boss名称，比如寒境费舍尔，流放中村光，厄运塔尔这些地狱笑话设计得还挺有意思。只能希望作者未来能好好改进这个游戏，顾及一下玩家的游玩体验，以及能解决一些平衡问题吧。最终我对这个游戏的的评价一句话来说就是对小丑牌拙劣的模仿。

游戏制作与设计我个人觉得挺有趣的，本质是下棋博弈，但融入了肉鸽的元素，于是一定的运气就显得重要了， 这对于打进阶6的玩家来说可能比较折磨，我从入坑打到进阶5用了大概3天，可单一个进阶6却耗费我3.5天，其实用无限皇后打起来还是比较简单见到最终boss， 但一不小心容易瞬间崩盘，本人就是这样8个后没看机制被开局连吃死了，极低的容错（落子无悔机制），与4个buff皇后对手的压制（实际是3个buff），加上boss吃子连走的高强度技能，强度是上来了， 但是嘛，进阶6通关没有奖励我是不能接受的，只是弹出两个成就未免太单调了，收入与支出不平衡啊，希望后续能加个小奖励，新奇兵也好，新可选正面buff（打自定义用）也不错。 总之8/10

I love Chess and Balatro but this game is super repetitive. Once you play a game or two you will figure the most OP gambits(items) and go for them every time. AI is trash and blunders constantly. A decent game with fun art and fully functional mechanics, so experience-wise there is nothing wrong. The problem is the content. Strategies range from chaotic but decent to frustrating and useless. There are absolutely paths that are clearly better than others, and plenty of mechanics that seem very weak until you try them out and they're somehow worse than you expected. My other reason for disliking the game is that it feels like the single most obvious way of making chess interesting was almost entirely ignored: fairy chess pieces! There's a couple upgrades that make pieces move in new ways, some even named after the equivalent fairy chess piece, but I could count these on one hand. There are *countless* ways to make chess pieces to interesting and varied things, both in how they move and how they capture, and it's super easy to find discussions about them online. The bosses are very cool visually and thematically with just a few scraps of lore to make them a little extra fun. Their mechanics are difficult, but I never found them actively obnoxious, just frustrating in the way that a challenge can be when you feel like your tools to overcome it aren't working right.

先说结论：这个游戏的底层逻辑就有问题——下棋本来就是件要取舍的事，而你想像Balatro一样只要运转好就啥都能赚到，在这个游戏里是（几乎）不可能的。通关一遍之后我就不想再玩了，它抄也就抄到了皮毛，根本没法做到像Balatro一样上头。 大体上借鉴（抄袭？）Balatro的游戏设计特色： 沉浸式的美术和及时反馈（虽然象棋+棋子永久死亡的玩法有一定的负反馈）。 整体音乐、美术等还是这个更胜一筹。（简中适配有点小问题） 感觉玩法上最大的问题就是“象棋”本身——你可以像玩Balatro一样搞运转（经济）、堆特性（塔罗牌/棋格）、堆数值（Balatro的加法、乘法运算/象棋的免费回合收益、放棋运转）， 但这样玩就失去了象棋的博弈性。 Balatro玩牌就是自己跟自己玩摸牌，抽到的牌好分就高，抽到的牌不好就烂完，而构筑是为了提上限，保下限的手段只有“增加手牌数、出牌数、弃牌数”，是一种“可控的运气游戏”，所以才容易上头； 而这款游戏有一个很矛盾的地方：你和电脑下象棋，理论上比的是你的棋局理解（回合与棋子之间的取舍），而它为了做成“类Balatro”的游戏，舍弃了棋局本身， 把回合、棋子数量作为成长手段（玩下来感觉一颗棋的上限也没多高）， 电脑下的棋局成了你要打的小怪、Boss（很多时候电脑会因为套用常规棋局逻辑打出铸币臭棋）， 如果我玩回合流，我思考半天还是要死几个棋；如果我玩棋子运转流，还得为了刷棋而绞尽脑汁思考如何获得最大收益，想爽爽不起来，想博弈又没有博弈感。 这也就是为什么你看宣传片觉得这个游戏很nb，而自己一上手玩了之后就觉得哪里怪怪的，没Balatro好玩。

Gambonanza is a fantastic blend of accessibility and depth. The visuals are clean and appealing, making it easy to jump in and learn the basics, while the strategic depth ensures it's challenging to truly master. Despite being inspired by chess, it's nowhere near as boring as traditional chess and manages to stay exciting throughout. A huge bonus for me is the macOS support, which lets me play while traveling on flights and bullet trains without needing a separate device. That's a feature I genuinely appreciate. I would highly recommend Gambonanza to anyone looking for a clever and entertaining strategy game. I'm also excited to see what the developers do next. A multiplayer mode or even a standalone game set in this universe could dramatically increase the game's popularity and take it to the next level.

This game is sick! I absolutely love it! Just got done with my second win, played it many hours straight now, lol. I know it shamelessly copies the aesthetic and flow of Balatro, but I don't think that's a bad thing. It's fun and addicting, especially if you have an itch to play chess, but not a full game. You end up playing some mini chess puzzles with the "Gambits", which are similar to the Jokers in Balatro. It makes for some interesting sessions. Having said how much I've enjoyed it so far, I want to leave some of my thoughts on how things could changed to maximize the game's potential. You can tell a lot of care and passion went into the development of the game, so to the devs out there, if you see this, I hope it's helpful / constructive feedback. Suggestions on the graphics and interface: - I think some of the animations could be punched up a bit. For example in some places things look a bit linear, whereas in Balatro the animations "pop" a bit more. Overall I think the aesthetic is 90% of what it could be, maybe with another pass on the animation curves it could be spiced up a bit to drive home those dopamine hits when you get a new piece, Gambit, or other stuff. - I like the color scheme, but it feels like it could use just a little more contrast or saturation. - The text can be quite small and difficult to read, even on large screens, especially for the Gambit tooltips. - I think there's a small bug in the logic for selecting the default screen resolution. I'm using a 3440x1440 monitor, and when I launched the game, it defaulted to 3440 wide, but something more than 1440 high, so some of the menus were cut off. I changed it to 1440 high and it was fine. - When multiple Gambit effects were triggered, it didn't seem to happen in sequence, but rather everything happened at the same time. If multiple Gambits have an effect for a single action, it would be nice if the animations for those effects played separately, and maybe were slowed down a bit so it was easier to see what was triggered. I think Balatro does this pretty well when multiple Jokers trigger for a hand. - It would be nice if the status for a piece was shown in a way that was a little more obvious, especially for the "Blessed" status. A couple of times I thought my piece was protected, but the effect had worn off. Suggestions for gameplay: - For a lot of my runs, I didn't make much use of the Gambits, because I had to keep buying pieces to restore lost material. With the more difficult rounds, you end up having to trade pieces to make progress, and it cuts down on the material you're left with when the round ends. This means you have to spend your money on pieces just to keep up, and it can start to feel like walking on a treadmill. - Sometimes the Gambits can feel a bit useless, depending on what you get. I didn't feel like there was as much synergy between the Gambits as there could be, at least for most of the time it felt like that. I will say that when things did line up, it was pretty awesome, and I did have a couple of combos that felt pretty overpowered, which was nice. But that only happened twice in probably 7 or 8 runs. - It seems like sometimes the computer makes very obviously bad moves. To me, this cheapens the overall experience, because it can start to feel like the game is overly random. At times I would just Wait on my turn, and rely on the computer to make a terrible move, then make an easy capture. I get that the game should be fun and winnable, but it might be better if there were some predictable rules that governed the play of the computer, for example, "always capture the piece with the highest value first, if a capture is possible, otherwise defend the highest value piece if one is threatened." This would make the gameplay more puzzle based. I did find that baiting the computer into capturing certain pieces was a good strategy to open up the board for some levels, but it was a bit of a dice roll as to what the computer would do. I guess that's not terrible, because it adds a bit of a gambling element in a way, but some moves by the computer were just dumb. When this happens, it makes you think, "Maybe I should just move around to avoid getting captured and then wait for the computer to make a dumb move." Maybe there could be a difficulty setting that wasn't tied to the cost/availability of Gambits and other powerups, but instead controlled the strength of the computer chess engine? - I think it would be pretty neat if the pieces themselves could be upgraded somehow. I like how Balatro had different different things that could be added to a card, like foil, holo, etc. I'm not exactly sure how that would work in this game, but it might be a nice complement to the tile upgrade system. Anyway, I've been enjoying the game, and I'd love to see it get a few more updates. Congrats to the devs on what they've managed to deliver so far. The bottom line is, if you like chess at all, and if you liked Balatro, it's definitely worth the 15 bucks.
